OLDFIELD PETS AFFILIATE TERMS & CONDITIONS

Welcome to Oldfield Pets! Thanks for joining our Affiliate program.

These following terms and conditions apply to individuals/companies who are accessing or using the Program both as a merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and an Affiliate (“you” or “affiliate” or “partner” or “ambassador”) who refers customers to use product or service from the merchant. By participating in the Program, Affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and are bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety, you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.

We reserve the right to approve or reject any Registration, even disabling the account after the approval, in our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your registration.

Please read all our guide, terms & conditions and policy documents. You are responsible to oblige to each rules mentioned in these files upon your registration, however some of them shall be revoked after the formal or informal agreements between the both parties.


Who is Oldfield Pets?

Oldfield Pets offers 100% Natural Products for Dogs, Cats, Chickens & Reptiles. Shop Natural Treats, Chews and Supplements along with Innovative Toys & Other Supplies.

Oldfield Pets delivers the best-in-class poultry-keeping products for raising happy, healthy birds from start to finish.


Who is the Oldfield Pets Partner?

We partner with individuals who are interested in promoting our products, offering a performance-based reward when they refer to a new order.

The guidelines apply to all “Oldfield Pets Partners” and it defines any company or individual customers, affiliates, ambassadors, influencers, bloggers, referrals and business associates who are interacting with Oldfield Pets brand.

Why become a partner with Oldfield Pets?

Oldfield Pets is a fast-growing company in the pets industry. We do not only offer you an experienced team that provides you advice and practical help, but also the high commissions and the low cancellation rate with various partnership models.

High average order value, providing affiliates with high earning potential per conversion.

We offer 15% commission for all products and our programs have a 30 days cookie period.

Monthly Paypal payment option with minimum $50 threshold for our affiliate program on hatchingtime.com

Receive support from our in-house affiliate success team.

Stay ahead with regular updates on promos, trends, and seasonal opportunities.

Free to join.


Who can join and what are the requirements?

Anyone passionate about poultry is welcome to join. Whether you're a blogger, influencer, at-home poultry enthusiast, homesteader, farm, breeder, hatchery or educator from the US, we're excited to partner with you.

If you have, the website must already be accessible and does not contain any wrongful content.

We value the content quality, audience fit and enthusiasm, no matter the number of followers you have. A large following is helpful but not required. If you share useful poultry or homesteading content and are willing to promote our products, you are welcome to apply.

  • Cashback & coupon & review & deal websites are prohibited to join our affiliate program.

How can I join & earn money with the Oldfield Pets Affiliate Programs?

You can join our in-house affiliate program on our website. We offer 15% commission sitewide for all products. If one of your viewers/visitors clicks our affiliate link, a cookie will be set. This cookie is valid for 30 days and attributes the customer to your account. Additionally, you’ll be assigned a dedicated coupon code, no matter the source of the clicked link, the commission will be granted if the user redeems your coupon at the checkout process.


Affiliates must accumulate at least $50 in earnings before a payout is initiated. Commissions are paid out approximately 60 days following the end of the month in which they were earned. After receiving your first payout, you are eligible for monthly payouts, provided you meet the $50 threshold each month. Commission amount is dependent on order value and not including extra fee (tax, shipping cost)


For an Affiliate to receive a commission, you need to specify the payment details on Settings. Payment schedule will be notified on Affiliate Guide page. Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. Use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy which gives merchant the right to review each and every referral order. Status of commission if displayed in Commission tab, any paid commission will be listed on Payment tab. Transactions that result in charge backs or refunds will not be paid out.


Given that Oldfield Pets affiliate program provides the best terms of cooperation all you have to do is follow the rules carefully and provide high-quality traffic. The traffic

you provide will be assessed according to the conversion rate and sales volumes as well as the number of new customers driven by your traffic source. After the approval your account, you’ll receive a guide document that explains the affiliate program and includes the promotional suggestions with examples. Our affiliate team is also happy to guide you for any assistance.


Please do not hesitate to reach out for any collaboration ideas, we are always happy to chat to work together.


What are the other affiliate programs I can join to promote Oldfield Pets?


Oldfield Pets is listed on Amazon, please review our Amazon store and popular products. You can promote our products via Amazon Associates - Amazon’s affiliate marketing program. Our product categories are eligible for a 3% - 5% commission rate for each Amazon sale. The policy regulations and terms & conditions, also tracking and payment are processed by Amazon.


If you have a Youtube channel and are eligible for Youtube Shopping Affiliate Program you can tag Oldfield Pets products in your videos. The actual commission rate is 15% for all listed products and 30 cookie days. You’ll get the commission with every sale once any of your viewers click the tagged products and make a purchase on our website. Therefore, the successful creators will be eligible to join our increased commission rate lists. The payment is processed to your Adsense account, and the policy regulation and terms & conditions, also tracking are processed by Google.


Similar to the Youtube program, our products are also listed for TikTok Shop Affiliate Program. If your account is eligible you can find our product in the marketplace to tag your TikTok videos. The policy regulations and terms & conditions, also tracking and payment are processed by TikTok platform.

Link & Coupon Usage


It is prohibited to submit individual coupons to cashback & coupon & review & deal websites.

A partner must not use the coupons to mislead the users with the incorrect amount discounts or other benefits.

Affiliate link is automatically generated, but you can also generate an affiliate link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else’s referral link and then later they click on yours, yours is the one that counts.

Partner might or might not be assigned to one coupon code with details and usage clarified on Dashboard. If customer both click on the affiliate link and use coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. If you’re not assigned a branded coupon, then you’re not allowed to promote the coupon.

Domain Usage

It is prohibited to use the Oldfield Pets trademark, including the Oldfield Pets or Oldfield Naturals name, in a domain name.

Example: oldfieldpetssellerxyz.com etc. is not permitted

A partner must use their own company name in any domain that is used to sell or promote Oldfield Pets or its products.

It is prohibited to use an identical or virtually identical Oldfield Pets trademark in a domain name.

Social Media Usage

A partner must use their own personal or company name and logo on their social handles.

Use of Oldfield Pets logos or icons on social media channels as the primary imagery is not permitted.

Use of our trademarked terms within social media handles, channel & profile names or titles of social pages is not permitted.

It is forbidden to create mobile applications, web pages and groups in social networks on behalf of Oldfield Pets as well as using Oldfield Pets logo.

No imagery within main images that could or might cause brand confusion are allowed to be used on social media profiles. Please do not use creative materials from our direct or indirect competitors on social networks.

No print or web copy may be copied from the Oldfield Pets website and other Oldfield Pets-owned properties; however, it’s allowed to reshare our social media posts and please reach us for any asset requests.

Advertising Usage

Brand bidding is prohibited. Bidding on branded terms (Oldfield Pets, Oldfield Naturals, Karnlea, Play9 etc.) on paid media campaigns is prohibited. All bidding keywords should exclude brand keywords and any variations or misspellings. The point is, you can't use combinations or variations that might be considered as Oldfield Pets's official promotion for bidding.

Therefore, bidding on Oldfield Pets non-branded terms (pet toy, cat food, dog supplements, etc.) is permitted.

Don’t use redirected pages and links to send a user to our site. Direct PPC linking is not permitted.

Ads must not contain or mimic any Oldfield Pets ads or web copy without written permission from Oldfield Pets.

The use of the Oldfield Pets brand term may not be used within the vanity URL within display advertisements (ex:sellerxyz.com/oldfieldpets)

Only the approved advertising material is permitted. All self-created display and banner ads pertaining to Oldfield Pets or its products must be approved by the Oldfield Pets Marketing Team.

Cookie spam, cookie-stuffing, forced clicks, click injection or any other unethical cookie & click fraud activities are strongly permitted.

Geo-targeting must be restricted ONLY to the United States, United Kingdom and Canada target markets.


Violations & Enforcement

Oldfield Pets actively monitors how our branding is being represented by our Partners.

If a partner violates the Oldfield Pets Partnership and Branding, Oldfield Pets will be in direct contact with the partner and will walk them through the necessary steps to get back in compliance within a reasonable and established timeframe.

If a partner refuses to comply, all commissions for the last 30 days will be declined, the partnership will be terminated and legal action may be taken.

The Merchant reserves the right to deactivate and subsequently terminate any Affiliate account that has remained inactive for a continuous period of 365 days or more. For the purposes of this Agreement, "inactivity" includes, but is not limited to: failure to log into the affiliate dashboard, unresponsiveness to multiple communication attempts from the Merchant, and the cessation of active promotion or distribution of assigned affiliate links and promotional coupons.


FAQs

I can’t log into my affiliate account. What should I do?

If you are unable to access your affiliate account or change the password, it is most likely a web browser configuration issue. To troubleshoot the issue, please try the following steps.

Log in with a PC or Mac. Phone browsers and tablets aren’t reliable for successful affiliate logins.

Ensure you are using the most recent version of your web browser.

Clean up your current web browser by clearing your cookies and cache.

Disable any third-party applications or add-ons for your browser that could affect cookies and scripts.

Close and restart the browser. Make sure cookies are enabled.

Your account might be disabled, make sure if you received a related email.


Where can I learn more about affiliate program?

You can review the UpPromote website to learn how to navigate on your account or learn the details of using the features. We also keep updating “Guide” and “Marketing Tools” sections to share helpful documents, banners or videos with you. Additionally, please make sure to subscribe to our newsletter as we constantly share updates about the promotions, product details and news about us.


How do I apply to become theOldfield Pets affiliate? 

Apply directly through our website. After approval, you’ll receive access to your dashboard, where you can find affiliate links, reporting tools, and payout information. The applications are reviewed within 7 business days.


After you sign up and get approved, you will have an active affiliate dashboard where you can access personalized links and coupons to use for promotion to earn.

How much and how do I get paid? 

We offer a 5% standard commission for all eligible affiliates. You'll earn from the total cart value excluding the tax and shipping value. Payments are sent via PayPal once the total commission reached to minimum threshold and referrals are approved & remained in aging period. Please make sure to update your payment information.

After you sign up and get approved, you will have an active affiliate dashboard where you can access personalized links and coupons to use for promotion to earn.

Which products earn commission?

All products qualify for commission. Full details are listed in the program terms and may change from time to time.

I have a pending commission on my affiliate account. When will I get paid?

All affiliate referrals go through appx. a 60-day aging period after the end of the month in which the sale occurred. All referrals still associated with active accounts after this period qualify for commissions which are paid out starting on the 1st of the month in which the aging period ends through the end of that same month. For example, commissions on referrals who purchased in January and have remained as valid transactions until March, they will be paid from April 1. Remember, payments are only issued if your payment field is successfully filled-out.


When do I know that the payment has been issued?

In your affiliate dashboard, click on Payment Information. Once your referral is approved its status will change to approved and once the payment has been processed, its status will change to paid. You can find the processed date and amount, as well as all other referral details.


Why am I rejected or my account is disabled?

Our team carefully review and accept the applications that suits most for our products and audience. The approved account may be denied due to our policy, terms and conditions. We encourage you to fill the registration form with as much as details and without any mistakes to avoid negative results. In case you have any questions or concerns, please feel free to contact us.
